ui.settings.tab.accessibility.hint: Theme, text, color-blind palettes, motion and flashes.
ui.settings.tab.game.label: GAME
ui.settings.tab.game.hint: Language, damage numbers, turn timer and notices.
ui.settings.tab.controls.label: CONTROLS
ui.settings.language.label: LANGUAGE
ui.settings.language.hint: Language for the game's text. AUTO uses Steam's language or, without Steam, your system's.

ui.settings.status.running: The game keeps running in multiplayer
ui.settings.confirm.leave_room: You leave the room; your party goes on without you.
ui.settings.confirm.account_saved: Your account and characters are saved.
ui.settings.sound.master.label: MASTER VOLUME
ui.settings.sound.master.hint: Raises or lowers everything at once.
ui.settings.sound.music.label: MUSIC
ui.settings.sound.sfx.label: EFFECTS (FX)
ui.settings.sound.sfx.hint: Hits, skills and loot. Plays a sample as you move it.
ui.settings.sound.mute.label: MUTE ALL
ui.settings.sound.mute.hint_off: Turns off music and effects without losing the volumes.
ui.settings.display.mode.label: MODE
ui.settings.display.mode.hint: Borderless fullscreen on the window's monitor.
ui.settings.display.scale.label: SCALING
ui.settings.display.scale.hint_fit: Fills the window; some pixels come out wider.
ui.settings.display.crt.label: CRT FILTER
ui.settings.display.crt.hint: Scanlines, glow and edges of an old TV.
ui.settings.display.particles.label: PARTICLES
ui.settings.display.particles.hint: Sparks, snow and glints. LOW if your PC struggles.
ui.settings.display.fps.label: FPS LIMIT
ui.settings.display.fps.hint: Frames per second. Unlimited = whatever the monitor allows.
ui.settings.display.perf.label: FPS AND PING
ui.settings.display.perf.hint: Shows frames per second in a corner and, in a room, the ping.
ui.settings.display.corner.label: CORNER
ui.settings.display.corner.hint_on: Where the FPS and ping display goes.
ui.settings.display.corner.hint_off: Turn on FPS AND PING to pick the corner.
ui.settings.a11y.theme.label: UI THEME
ui.settings.a11y.theme.hint_blue: The classic: navy panels and colored text.
ui.settings.a11y.theme.hint_dark: Near-black neutral panels; gold only marks selection and focus.
ui.settings.a11y.theme.hint_high_contras: Black background, white text, yellow focus and thick borders. Color only where it means something.
ui.settings.a11y.text_colors.label: TEXT COLORS
ui.settings.a11y.text_colors.hint_forced: HIGH CONTRAST always uses colors by role.
ui.settings.a11y.text_colors.hint_reduce: By role: names in white, light gray descriptions, dimmed data, one accent for values; green / red, rarities and statuses stay the same.
ui.settings.a11y.text_colors.hint_full: Each text with its own colors (as in v0.8.0).
ui.settings.a11y.spacing.label: SPACING
ui.settings.a11y.spacing.hint: WIDE: more line height, room between lines and rows, and dividers between card sections.
ui.settings.a11y.text_size.label: TEXT SIZE
ui.settings.a11y.text_size.hint_enormous: HUGE: twice NORMAL. Panels scroll and long cards switch to columns.
ui.settings.a11y.text_size.hint: Text in menus, cards, chat and battle. Snaps to the font grid to stay crisp.
ui.settings.a11y.font.label: READING FONT
ui.settings.a11y.font.hint_atkinson: Atkinson Hyperlegible: designed for low vision, letters that are hard to confuse (I l 1, O 0). Not pixel.
ui.settings.a11y.font.hint: Cards, chat, menus and battle. Titles and buttons only change with the option below.
ui.settings.a11y.titles.label: TITLES IN READING FONT
ui.settings.a11y.titles.hint_classic: With CLASSIC, titles already use the same font.
ui.settings.a11y.titles.hint: Titles, buttons and tabs in the reading font instead of pixel capitals.
ui.settings.a11y.letters.label: LETTER SPACING
ui.settings.a11y.letters.hint: WIDE: a little more room between letters in reading text.
ui.settings.a11y.notices.label: NOTICE DURATION
ui.settings.a11y.notices.hint_normal: Loot, build, chat, points and mission notices: a few seconds.
ui.settings.a11y.notices.hint_long: Notices stay on screen twice as long.
ui.settings.a11y.notices.hint_until_dism: They stay until closed with their {close} or with Backspace (closes all).
ui.settings.a11y.map_labels.label: MAP TEXT BACKDROP
ui.settings.a11y.map_labels.hint: Behind names, signs, notices and floor loot, to read them over busy tiles.
ui.settings.a11y.battle_log.label: BATTLE LOG
ui.settings.a11y.battle_log.hint_extende: EXTENDED: the last 3 lines above the scene; each one stays longer.
ui.settings.a11y.battle_log.hint: One line above the scene, replaced with each action.
ui.settings.a11y.text_detail.label: TEXTS
ui.settings.a11y.text_detail.hint_full: DETAILED: numbers, scaling and rules in every description.
ui.settings.a11y.text_detail.hint_summar: Short, simple descriptions. In tooltips, MORE DETAIL shows the full text.
ui.settings.a11y.vision.label: COLORBLIND MODE
ui.settings.a11y.vision.hint_off: Colors for green / red (deuteranopia, protanopia) or blue / yellow (tritanopia). The {up} {down} arrows and rarity letters always stay.
ui.settings.a11y.vision.hint_deuteranopi: Green / red: better in blue and worse in amber; blue HP and yellow MP; light blue break.
ui.settings.a11y.vision.hint_protanopia: Red: like deuteranopia, no reds (they look dark): bad things in light amber.
ui.settings.a11y.vision.hint_tritanopia: Blue / yellow: better in teal and worse in red; teal HP and magenta MP; pink Rare.
ui.settings.a11y.motion.label: REDUCE MOTION
ui.settings.a11y.motion.hint_on: No shake, no blinking, no camera zoom on ULTs, still arena and a short fade into and out of battle. Flashes at most SOFT.
ui.settings.a11y.motion.hint_off: Turns off shake, blinking and ULT zoom, and softens flashes and transitions.
ui.settings.a11y.shake.label: SCREEN SHAKE
ui.settings.a11y.shake.hint: The battle scene shakes on heavy hits.
ui.settings.a11y.flashes.label: FLASHES
ui.settings.a11y.flashes.hint: Full-screen flashes (red when taking a heavy hit, white on brutal hits, ULTs and ascension). {still, select, yes{With REDUCE MOTION, at most SOFT.} other{SOFT or OFF if they bother you.}}
ui.settings.a11y.darkness.label: DARKNESS
ui.settings.a11y.darkness.hint: How dark night and dark dungeons get. SOFT lightens shadows; OFF keeps everything like daytime.

ui.settings.game.numbers.label: FLOATING NUMBERS
ui.settings.game.numbers.hint: Damage and heals floating over each character.
ui.settings.game.turn.label: TURN TIMER
ui.settings.game.turn.hint: How long battle waits for your choice. In multiplayer the room host's setting applies.
ui.settings.game.confirm_drop.label: CONFIRM DROP
ui.settings.game.confirm_drop.hint: Asks before dropping an item on the floor. Selling and salvaging always ask.
ui.settings.game.build_notices.label: BUILD NOTICES
ui.settings.game.build_notices.hint: Banner and chat line when a goal of your build plan advances (character's BUILD tab).
ui.settings.game.chat.label: CHAT
ui.settings.game.chat.hint: HIDDEN: a CHAT [ENTER] pill with new messages; Enter or click opens it.
ui.settings.game.chat_notices.label: CHAT NOTICES
ui.settings.game.chat_notices.hint: With chat hidden, important notices (mission accepted, floor cleared, level up) show for 4 s.
ui.settings.controls.map.hidden_loot.act: Also show loot hidden by the filter
ui.settings.controls.map.flame.action: Wandering flame (more light; at night you are seen from afar)
ui.settings.controls.map.big_map.action: Large map (arrows / drag: move; + - / wheel: zoom)
ui.settings.controls.battle.pass.action: Go to PASS (P again: pass the turn; the next one comes sooner)
